headline: Riera Renovation / LABLANCA
context: Riera is the renovation of a flat in a 1960s building, located along the former course of the Riera de Matamoros, in the historic centre of Badalona . The plot has elongated proportions, and the depth of the floor plan is interrupted by a courtyard.
